result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 1 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed SecurityConfig, service/controller security-event logs, datasource properties, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, oracle-init/create-user.sh and .env.example. Passwords use required environment references (Compose/shell :? operators are failure messages, not fallback passwords). Example env values are replacement placeholders, not evidence of deployed secrets. BCrypt generates salts; no hard-coded cryptographic key, broad filesystem permission assignment or explicit excessive Oracle grant confirmed. No .env present. All secret values redacted; deployed IAM and filesystem modes are unknown.
Static source review only; no builds, tests, exploit execution, dependency internals, or generated code reviewed. NOT_FOUND is not proof of absence.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

evidence.explanation: PhotoServiceImpl.uploadPhoto:179-180 and deletePhoto:212 log successful security-critical mutations with only filename/photo ID. DetailController.deletePhoto:69 similarly logs only the photo ID. None includes the authenticated principal or audit correlation identifying who performed the mutation, and no application audit listener is configured. Consequently application mutation logs cannot attribute an upload/deletion to its authenticated actor. This finding concerns omitted actor details in application logs; external proxy/security audit capabilities were not assessed.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
